ratios.facility: Credit Agreement (Revolving Credit Facility and Term Facility)
ratios.quote: The Credit Agreement also contains financial covenants that require the Company to maintain a Consolidated Interest Coverage Ratio (as defined in the Credit Agreement) of not less than 3.00 to 1.00 and to maintain a Consolidated Leverage Ratio of 3.75 to 1.00 or less for each fiscal quarter

parsed.notes: The excerpt gives only the covenant requirements, not the actual ratios. The leverage limit can rise if the company elects an acquisition-related increase. The Original Credit Agreement had the same 3.00x and 3.75x covenants; it has been superseded, so it is not listed separately. Also excluded: the 2.75x Consolidated First Lien Secured Leverage Ratio, which only sets incremental facility capacity, and the leverage-based pricing grids for margins and fees.
